advisory.finding: ReplayRecorder's non-determinism guard — the ValueError raised when real Pandoc produces different bytes for the same prepared input — has no test forcing it. This guard is the load-bearing property that makes committing static replay outputs safe (a non-deterministic converter would otherwise be silently frozen into fixtures), yet test_replay_fixture_captures_every_required_settling_conversion only feeds self-consistent outputs, so the mismatch branch never executes.

Each is a concrete corruption-detection guard for the committed fixtures with no assertion covering it.
